verified.installationAuthentication: GitHub App JWTs mint request-scoped installation tokens that are not returned, persisted, audited, or passed to companions.
verified.repositoryAndPolicyValidation: Repository enumeration, check runs, status contexts, and pull-request reviews use bounded pagination; publication revalidates protected branch, reviewed SHA, pull request, effective checks, and effective reviews before a reviewed-SHA merge.
verified.publicationBoundary: Legacy clone, remote Git actions, provider routes, UI actions, tool definitions, shared PAT variables, and companion Git credentials are retired. Companions are restricted to an internal network and execution uses a direct executable allowlist without a shell.
verified.webhookBoundary: GitHub webhook HMAC is computed over exact request bytes and deliveries are durably deduplicated without storing provider credentials or raw secrets.
verified.proxyBoundary: The same-origin proxy uses a fixed route and method allowlist, bounds request bodies, excludes cookies and authorization headers, forwards only content type plus the payload-bound approval header, and rejects retired publication routes before transport.
verified.identityBoundary: Installation repository discovery requires a server-verified platform principal or short-lived signed human identity scoped to the workspace.
